drone_interaction.vision_modality: Hyperspectral leaf-reflectance for succulent cell turgor & lipid accumulation
drone_interaction.harvest_tool: Multi-blade micro-shears executing cut-and-come-again pruning 2 cm above root crown

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Direct free radical quenching and upregulation of endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS)
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Vascular endothelium relaxation, reduced LDL lipid peroxidation
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Fresh leaf ingestion or light flash-steaming

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Precursor to EPA/DHA synthesis; competitively reduces arachidonic acid inflammatory cascades
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Anti-inflammatory, cardiovascular support, and membrane lipid homeostasis
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Direct dietary consumption of raw succulent foliage

penalties_and_risks: Accumulates soluble oxalates; requires circadian-synchronized harvesting when CAM organic acid levels are lowest.
Sprawling prostrate growth habit can cause optical occlusion if vertical LED distance drifts.
human_culinary_use: Crisp, thick succulent leaves with a tart, slightly lemony crunch. Delicious raw in salads, stir-fries, or blended into cold summer soups.
